Verbatim from the pinned category taxonomy snapshot and the public JSONL export: every en:-prefixed node whose English name begins with a lowercase letter, six control nodes whose names must come back byte-identical, real products carrying them, and the complete upward closure of every id named here. Names are projected to en/es/fr/xx, the languages these tests render in; not one name is edited, which is the point — the fixture records what upstream says, and the fix is about how a label is presented, not about correcting the source.
